comments.body: This does warn if you pass `-Wuninitialized` ([Godbolt Example](https://godbolt.org/z/j1v31G956)). That said, this should likely produce a verification error at the least (if not an outright error).

> This does warn if you pass `-Wuninitialized` ([Godbolt Example](https://godbolt.org/z/j1v31G956)).

Oh that's good to know. Should we enable that warning by default?

We've had that discussion a few times. I think we should, but we had some people express concerns about it being noisy, and producing false-positives due to inaccuracies in our ASTs (those should be fixed by #5377).

Some related issues:
* #2419 lists differences between FXC and DXC with regard to uninitialized values.
* #2494 shows cases where DXC generates invalid warnings for struct types because the ASTs incorrectly represent parameter passing.

Because of #2494 I think there is a strong argument to not enable `-Wuninitialized` by default until #5377 merges.

cc @tex3d & @pow2clk
Although we're unlikely to fix this in the frontend, the validator should have caught it so we should use this bug to track fixing the validator.
